listing.name: Ridge Racer V (Fukami)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows, macOS Apple Silicon and SteamOS 3.7+ packages; first-run CHD/CUE import Limits: PS2 USA SLUS-20002; supported user-file route with published SHA256SUMS. Other Linux distributions are explicitly untested. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP, macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 ZIP, SteamOS3.7+ Linux x86-64 archive. Other Linux distributions untested upstream. Original data: Own Ridge Racer V USA PS2 disc SLUS-20002 as CHD or CUE with companion BIN. First launch checks the USA disc hashes and extracts its files. This is the original Ridge Racer V PS2 game; other regions are unsupported. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
